ai_usage_statement: Artificial intelligence (AI), including large language models accessed through OpenAI ChatGPT and Codex, has been used for literature discovery, bibliographic organization, and preparation of the website, manuscript, and scripts. AI-assisted content may contain mistakes. If you find a mistake, please let us know.
conflict_of_interest_statement: Shreyas Sen is a founder, Chairman and Chief Technology Officer of Quasistatics, Inc. (doing business as Ixana). This affiliation is disclosed as a potential competing interest. The survey includes publications coauthored by Shreyas Sen.
inclusion_request: We may have missed relevant papers. If you would like a relevant paper published in a Tier-1 journal or conference to be considered for inclusion, please email shreyas@purdue.edu with its title, full citation, and DOI or source link. Requests will be reviewed for inclusion.
corrections: If you find a mistake, please email shreyas@purdue.edu with the paper identifier or DOI and a description of the error. Reported issues will be reviewed, and confirmed corrections will be incorporated into subsequent updates.
